profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Goal:  To work at a challenging and rewarding position which will provide opportunities to advance my knowledge, skills, and career.

Experience: 20+ years of experience in software development

Areas of experience:

- Large project ownership and supervision of other engineers and offshore teams

- Linux device driver development (kernel level)

- Linux userspace system-level development

- Android Platform development

- Android application development

- ARM SoC driver development, debugging, validation

- Debugging of new silicon issues such as high-speed signal integrity issues, controller timing issues, and various peripheral issues.

- Video encoding and decoding, including working with h264 in detail

- Audio data handling, real-time requirements, etc.

- Basic QEMU/hypervisor development (basic usage and understanding of virtio, etc.)

positions.description: Skills: OTA · Storage · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Linux Kernel · Embedded Software · Embedded Linux · Software Architecture · Linux System

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Echo device platform development, including Linux kernel and system programming.  A large portion of time spent on two main areas:
- system OTA updates
- The storage stack (filesystems, partitioning, etc.) with emphasis on raw unmanaged NAND

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Hypori offers a product which consists of running Android in the cloud, accessed through a thin client application on a mobile device (iOS and Android).  We developed our own Android platform, hypervisor modifications, and Android and iOS thin client applications, providing virtual smartphone instances on demand.

I joined Hypori in its very early stages as the second developer hired and have been involved in various areas of the Android virtual device platform, the hypervisor and Android client.  I have two primary areas of focus.  The first is the processing of the virtual display from the virtual device to the client.  This involves intelligent processing and encoding of the frame buffer data, transportation to the client, and decoding on the client.  My second main area of focus is encoding and transportation of forward and reverse path of audio data between the client and virtual device for audio playback and record.  This involves setting up audio playback and record on our Android client, audio codec encoding and decoding on the client and virtual device, and the transport between them.

As is typical in a startup, I commonly spend time outside of my main areas as needed.  In our Android client application, I've done various other work such as writing a class to help synchronize and manage Activity lifecycles (something finally included with Android O), added a headphone detection mechanism, some basic work with Views and video rendering, and various other small tasks and debugging.

In our hypervisor, I've done various work necessary for our audio and video processing and some basic communication debugging as needed.

In our virtual device which runs Android as the guest OS, I implemented the audio HAL and virtual audio emulation that provides a lower latency than some existing hypervisor / kernel audio emulation solutions.  On the video side, I've also worked with the stagefright code occasionally to debug issues, instrument certain activities, etc.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for the i.MX application processor products.  My experience here was very similar to my SigmaTel experience except for the software platform which was Linux instead of an RTOS.  Developed Linux device drivers in the power management areas for the i.MX23, i.MX28, and other parts including cpufreq drivers, power supply drivers, thermal management drivers, and external memory interface drivers.

While as Freescale, I worked at Linaro on a one-year assignment and made some core driver contributions the power management area as well as contributions for the i.MX processors.

positions.title: Developer, Power Management Team (on assignment from Freescale)
positions.description: One year assignment at Linaro while working for Freescale.  See Linux kernel commits by rob.lee@linaro.org to see some of my work.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Developement Engineer
positions.description:
Sigmatel created mixed signal SoC products for portable audio players (mp3 players).  Their parts were used by Apple, Samsung, Creative, Sony and many others.

I developed drivers and perform some amount of validation for the power management system including the clock management, suspend and resume handling, power gating,  thermal management,  and integrated power supplies.  I also developed the external memory drivers, LRADC driver, and helped with validation and support of these areas as well.  The software platform was a homegrown SDK/BSP developed around the ThreadX RTOS.

positions.title: Firmware Developer
positions.description:
- Firmware developer on GPS wireless communication fleet tracking

- Developed test software and performed testing on various unix based system software

positions.title: Power System Engineer
positions.description: Worked in system standards group analyzing equipment failure, testing new equipment, and specifying new equipement.

positions.title: Co-op/Intern Engineer
positions.description: Worked at various internship roles over two spring and two summer semesters.  Roles included System Protection, Home Automation group (TeComm), and Operations.
